title: Toolbot tool definition
description: tools/<name>/tool.yaml. Editor aid only: `toolbot validate` is authoritative and also enforces cross-field rules (duplicate destinations, ambiguous matchers, provider capabilities).

name.description: Tool name; must equal the directory name.

version.description: Current version WITHOUT tag prefix, quoted. Toolbot updates this.

tag.description: Upstream tag template with exactly one {version}, e.g. "v{version}", "release-{version}", "cli-v{version}".

versioning.description: How versions are parsed and ordered.

prereleases.description: Also propose prereleases (e.g. 2.0.0-rc.1 or releases marked as prerelease upstream).

ignore.description: Versions never proposed: exact ("0.9.0") or constraints (">=2.0.0", ">=1.4, <1.5").

allow.description: Constraints every proposed version must satisfy, e.g. "<2.0.0" (stay on 1.x) or "==1.4.2" (pin).

provider.description: Required unless host is a host name from toolbot.yaml.

host.description: A host name from toolbot.yaml (e.g. internal-gitlab) or an https base URL for GitHub Enterprise / self-managed GitLab. Defaults to github.com / gitlab.com.

versions.description: releases: GitHub/GitLab releases. tags: plain git tags, for projects that never create releases (assets must then use url or path).

version-files.description: Version pins in other files that are bumped with the tool, e.g. .terraform-version or a Dockerfile ARG.

path.description: Relative to tools/<name>/, or to the repository root with a leading "/", e.g. "/.terraform-version".

template.description: Text containing {version} or {tag}, e.g. "ARG TERRAFORM_VERSION={version}". The text for the current version is replaced with the text for the new one.

name.description: Exact release asset name; may use {version} and {tag}.

pattern.description: Glob (* and ?) that must match exactly one release asset; may use {version} and {tag}.

url.description: Download URL (https) for tools published outside release assets, e.g. Terraform; may use {version} and {tag}.

path.description: A file committed in the source repository, read at the release tag, e.g. "dist/linux/tool"; may use {version} and {tag}.

extract.description: The download is a zip/tar(.gz/.xz/.bz2) archive: commit only this file from it, e.g. "terraform" or "linux-amd64/helm". The checksum is verified on the archive.

destination.description: Path relative to tools/<name>/, or to the repository root with a leading "/" (e.g. "/bin/terraform").

executable.description: Commit with the executable bit. Default: true when the destination has no extension (or is .sh/.bash/.py).

type.description: none: no verification. provider: digest reported by the provider API (GitHub release assets only). file: a checksum file.

file.description: type=file: release asset holding checksums, e.g. "{asset}.sha256", "SHA256SUMS", "checksums.txt".

url.description: type=file: URL of the checksum file instead of a release asset, e.g. "https://get.helm.sh/{asset}.sha256sum".

path.description: type=file: checksum file committed in the source repository at the release tag, e.g. "dist/SHA256SUMS".
